summary: Daily verified benchmark routing by tool and task class

delivery.outcome: Class-aware executor routing with one persistent daily validated benchmark campaign, explainable task-specific ranking and user timer using isolated fixtures. Preserve explicit client/model choice and benchmark evidence.
nonGoals: Restoring or modifying unrelated user stashes
Driving an unverified user GUI session
Treating CLI exit0 as independently verified task success

architecture.decision: Separate pure contracts/classification/ranking, transactional SQLite campaign ledger and bounded isolated adapters; CLI is a thin orchestrator; timer and CLI share one local-date claim. Structured task classes simple/complex/other, tool classes deterministic/api/cli/ide;gillm remains transport.

dataChanges.description: Host-scoped SQLite campaigns and independently validated probe results

architecture.rollback: Disable user timer and revert ticket326 material commit; retain database and preserved stashes.

validation.evidence: Classification,explicit override,capability filters,quality-gate outcome,date/DST,daily cross-process claim,crash/restart,versions/freshness and unknown cost.
Managed governance passes; source scope and lease match.
Offline fixture smoke and bounded authorized real available tool campaign record truthful outcomes; no unverified GUI typing.
